parameters.content:
## Core AI Brain (Sub-Workflow)
Called by every platform handler via **Execute Workflow**.

**Input** (passthrough): `chatbotId, sessionId, platform, userMessage, mediaType, mediaUrl, customerInfo`
**Output**: `replyText, galleryImages[], isOrderCreated`

### Setup
1. Set env var `GOOGLE_GEMINI_API_KEY` (used by Embed / Vision / Transcribe HTTP nodes).
2. Copy this workflow's ID into each platform handler's *Execute Core AI Brain* node.
3. RAG is scoped per-tenant: `chatbotId` column OR `metadata->>'chatbotId'` (mirrors lib/ai/rag.ts getContext).

parameters.query:
SELECT
  c."chatbotId",
  c."userId",
  c."workspaceId",
  c."model",
  c."systemPrompt",
  c."temperature",
  c."maxTokens",
  c."chatbotMode",
  u."plan",
  u."creditsBalance",
  ec."productSheetUrl",
  ec."productSheetName"
FROM "chatbot"."Chatbot" c
JOIN "app_auth"."User" u ON c."userId" = u."userId"
LEFT JOIN "ecommerce"."EcommerceConfig" ec ON ec."chatbotId" = c."chatbotId"
WHERE c."chatbotId" = '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.chatbotId }}'
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO "chatbot"."ChatSession" ("id","chatbotId","sessionId","platform","isActive","createdAt","updatedAt")
VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid()::text,
  '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.chatbotId }}',
  '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.sessionId }}',
  '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.platform || 'web' }}',
  true,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT ("chatbotId","sessionId") DO UPDATE SET "updatedAt" = NOW();

parameters.jsonBody: ={ "contents": [ { "parts": [ { "text": "Transcribe this audio to text verbatim. Return only the transcript." }, { "inline_data": { "mime_type": {{ JSON.stringify($binary.data.mimeType) }}, "data": {{ JSON.stringify($binary.data.data) }} } } ] } ] }

parameters.query:
SELECT content
FROM "chatbot"."Chunk"
WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    "chatbotId" = '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.chatbotId }}'
    OR metadata->>'chatbotId' = '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.chatbotId }}'
  )
ORDER BY embedding <=> '[{{ $json.embedding.values.join(',') }}]'::vector
LIMIT 5;

options.systemMessage:
={{ $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.systemPrompt + "

=== KNOWLEDGE BASE CONTEXT ===
Use ONLY the retrieved context below to answer general questions (FAQs, policies, delivery, company info). If the answer is not here and it is not a product or order task, tell the customer you will connect them with a human agent.

" + ($json.knowledgeContext || "(no relevant knowledge found)") + "

=== LANGUAGE RULES ===
1. Detect the customer language (English, Bangla, or Banglish) and ALWAYS reply in that same language and script.
2. Never refuse to speak Bangla. Keep product names, sizes and IDs in their original script.

=== TONE & FORMATTING ===
1. Be friendly, natural and human. Greet only in the first message of a conversation.
2. Use clean spacing, bullet points and relevant emojis.
3. When you show a product image, put the image URL on its OWN line prefixed with '[IMG] '. These lines are turned into an image gallery and removed from the visible reply text.

=== TOOLS ===
1. 'Product Lookup' - call FIRST for ANY product question (name, price, stock, size, colour, material, availability). Never guess product data.
2. 'Create Order' - call ONLY after the customer has confirmed items, quantity, name, phone and full delivery address. Never invent missing details; ask for them first." }}

parameters.toolDescription: Look up LIVE product catalogue info (name, price, stock, colours, sizes, description, images) for this store. ALWAYS call before answering any product question.
parameters.query:
SELECT "productId","name","description","price","currency","stock","variants","imageUrl","imageUrls"
FROM "ecommerce"."Product"
WHERE "chatbotId" = '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.chatbotId }}'
  AND "isActive" = true
  AND (
    "name" ILIKE '%' || '{{ $fromAI('product_name', 'the product name or keyword the customer asked about', 'string') }}' || '%'
    OR "description" ILIKE '%' || '{{ $fromAI('product_name', 'the product name or keyword the customer asked about', 'string') }}' || '%'
  )
LIMIT 10;

parameters.toolDescription: Create a confirmed customer order. Call ONLY when items, quantity, customer name, phone and full delivery address are all known and confirmed.
parameters.query:
INSERT INTO "ecommerce"."Order" ("id","orderId","chatbotId","sessionId","customerName","customerPhone","deliveryAddress","district","items","totalAmount","paymentMethod","paymentStatus","status","createdAt","updatedAt")
VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid()::text,
  'ORD-' || upper(substring(md5(random()::text) from 1 for 6)),
  '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.chatbotId }}',
  '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.sessionId }}',
  '{{ $fromAI('customer_name', 'customer full name', 'string') }}',
  '{{ $fromAI('customer_phone', 'customer phone number', 'string') }}',
  '{{ $fromAI('delivery_address', 'full delivery address', 'string') }}',
  '{{ $fromAI('district', 'district or city, empty string if unknown', 'string') }}',
  '{{ $fromAI('items_json', 'a JSON array string of ordered items, each an object with name, qty and price', 'string') }}'::jsonb,
  {{ $fromAI('total_amount', 'the total order amount as a number', 'number') }},
  'COD',
  'pending',
  'Processing',
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
RETURNING "orderId";

UPDATE "chatbot"."ChatSession"
SET "lastMessage" = '{{ $('Format Response').item.json.replyText.replace(/'/g, "''").slice(0, 500) }}',
    "updatedAt" = NOW()
WHERE "chatbotId" = '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.chatbotId }}'
  AND "sessionId" = '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.sessionId }}';

INSERT INTO "chatbot"."ChatMessage" ("id","chatbotId","userId","sessionId","role","content","timestamp")
VALUES
  (gen_random_uuid()::text, '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.chatbotId }}', '{{ $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.userId }}', '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.sessionId }}', 'user', '{{ $('Merge Media').item.json.resolvedMessage.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 second'),
  (gen_random_uuid()::text, '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.chatbotId }}', '{{ $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.userId }}', '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.sessionId }}', 'assistant', '{{ $('Format Response').item.json.replyText.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', NOW());

UPDATE "app_auth"."User"
SET "creditsBalance" = CASE WHEN "plan" = 'enterprise' THEN "creditsBalance" ELSE GREATEST(0, "creditsBalance" - (CASE WHEN '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.model || $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.model }}' IN ('google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite', 'google/gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001', 'meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct', 'google/gemma-2-9b-it', 'deepseek/deepseek-chat') THEN 5 WHEN '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.model || $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.model }}' IN ('openai/gpt-4o', 'anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet', 'deepseek/deepseek-r1', 'openai/o1-preview', 'openai/o1-mini', 'google/gemini-pro-1.5', 'mistralai/mistral-large') THEN 50 ELSE 15 END)) END,
    "creditsUsedThisCycle" = CASE WHEN "plan" = 'enterprise' THEN "creditsUsedThisCycle" ELSE "creditsUsedThisCycle" + (CASE WHEN '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.model || $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.model }}' IN ('google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite', 'google/gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001', 'meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct', 'google/gemma-2-9b-it', 'deepseek/deepseek-chat') THEN 5 WHEN '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.model || $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.model }}' IN ('openai/gpt-4o', 'anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet', 'deepseek/deepseek-r1', 'openai/o1-preview', 'openai/o1-mini', 'google/gemini-pro-1.5', 'mistralai/mistral-large') THEN 50 ELSE 15 END) END
WHERE "userId" = '{{ $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.userId }}';

INSERT INTO "billing"."CreditTransaction" ("id", "userId", "chatbotId", "action_type", "model_tier", "credits_spent", "metadata", "createdAt")
VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid()::text,
  '{{ $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.userId }}',
  '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.chatbotId }}',
  'reply_' || (CASE WHEN '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.model || $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.model }}' IN ('google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite', 'google/gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001', 'meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct', 'google/gemma-2-9b-it', 'deepseek/deepseek-chat') THEN 'economy' WHEN '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.model || $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.model }}' IN ('openai/gpt-4o', 'anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet', 'deepseek/deepseek-r1', 'openai/o1-preview', 'openai/o1-mini', 'google/gemini-pro-1.5', 'mistralai/mistral-large') THEN 'premium' ELSE 'standard' END),
  CASE WHEN '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.model || $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.model }}' IN ('google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite', 'google/gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001', 'meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct', 'google/gemma-2-9b-it', 'deepseek/deepseek-chat') THEN 'economy' WHEN '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.model || $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.model }}' IN ('openai/gpt-4o', 'anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet', 'deepseek/deepseek-r1', 'openai/o1-preview', 'openai/o1-mini', 'google/gemini-pro-1.5', 'mistralai/mistral-large') THEN 'premium' ELSE 'standard' END,
  CASE WHEN '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.model || $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.model }}' IN ('google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite', 'google/gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001', 'meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct', 'google/gemma-2-9b-it', 'deepseek/deepseek-chat') THEN 5 WHEN '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.model || $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.model }}' IN ('openai/gpt-4o', 'anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet', 'deepseek/deepseek-r1', 'openai/o1-preview', 'openai/o1-mini', 'google/gemini-pro-1.5', 'mistralai/mistral-large') THEN 50 ELSE 15 END,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'sessionId', '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.sessionId }}',
    'chatbotId', '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.chatbotId }}',
    'channel', LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.channel }}', ''), NULLIF('{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.platform }}', ''), 'web')),
    'modelId', '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.model || $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.model }}',
    'promptTokens', {{ $('Format Response').item.json.promptTokens }},
    'completionTokens', {{ $('Format Response').item.json.completionTokens }},
    'totalTokens', {{ $('Format Response').item.json.totalTokens }}
  ),
  NOW()
);

INSERT INTO "billing"."AIUsageLog" (
  "id", "userId", "workspaceId", "chatbotId", "sessionId", "channel",
  "model", "modelId", "promptTokens", "completionTokens", "totalTokens",
  "costUsd", "costBdt", "creditsDeducted", "isFreeMessage", "createdAt"
)
VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid()::text,
  '{{ $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.userId }}',
  '{{ $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.workspaceId }}',
  '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.chatbotId }}',
  '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.sessionId }}',
  LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.channel }}', ''), NULLIF('{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.platform }}', ''), 'web')),
  '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.model || $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.model }}',
  '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.model || $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.model }}',
  {{ $('Format Response').item.json.promptTokens }},
  {{ $('Format Response').item.json.completionTokens }},
  {{ $('Format Response').item.json.totalTokens }},
  {{ $('Format Response').item.json.costUsd }},
  {{ $('Format Response').item.json.costBdt }},
  CASE WHEN '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.model || $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.model }}' IN ('google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite', 'google/gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001', 'meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct', 'google/gemma-2-9b-it', 'deepseek/deepseek-chat') THEN 5 WHEN '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.model || $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.model }}' IN ('openai/gpt-4o', 'anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet', 'deepseek/deepseek-r1', 'openai/o1-preview', 'openai/o1-mini', 'google/gemini-pro-1.5', 'mistralai/mistral-large') THEN 50 ELSE 15 END,
  false,
  NOW()
);
